items.headline: Frost Advisory issued October 17 at 7:47AM EDT until October 18 at 9:00AM EDT by NWS Cleveland OH
items.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures as low as 35 will result in frost formation.

* WHERE...In Ohio, Ashtabula Lakeshore and Lake Counties. In
Pennsylvania, Northern Erie County.

* WHEN...From 1 AM to 9 AM EDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Frost could harm sensitive outdoor vegetation. Sensitive
outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.
items.instruction: Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.
